commands_used: answer 1. I am on my own errand, not the order's: a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, which Never-Writes-Twice dismissed. The order's hunt at Bell Station can wait. 2. Get into the fort's keep and see its cellar, starting with the wall captain Sakeeus-Wan at the gate. 3. Ask the captain for leave to enter, or find a quiet way in unseen; the keep door is locked and no pick opens it, and the garrison attacks anyone caught inside without leave. 4. I do not know what moans in the cellar or why the Unbound care; I can find out by talking to the captain and exploring.

answer 1. The captain will open the keep and pay 100 gold if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing chalk carts on the western approach. I still want to see the cellar for the Unbound scout's question. 2. Kill the three raiders on the western approach, then report to Sakeeus-Wan. 3. Fight the raiders (the game says the trapdoor way is favoured, though), or look for another way in unseen. 4. I do not know what the trapdoor is or where it is; the old prison below the keep is said to be the order's. I could explore the fort.
use Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom

answer 1. I got into the cellar guardroom unseen through the unlocked yard trapdoor. If the garrison catches me they attack. I am still on my own errand to learn what moans in the cellar. 2. Look at the sap jars in the quartermaster's store, speak to the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku, and try the cellar door, all here. 3. Do those three in any order; talk to the gaoler, try the locked cellar door (I have lockpicks), or go up to the store. 4. I do not know what the sap jars (Jal-Veesa Knot) mean or what is behind the cellar door; I can look and ask the gaoler.
use Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom
pick Door to Cellar Door win

answer 1. The Toh-Reel-Ka keeps something or someone moaning behind the locked cellar door at Fort Chalkmoth and feeds it Hist sap tied with the knot of Jal-Veesa's tree-minder, though the fort has no Hist. Never-Writes-Twice, who dismissed the question, holds the key. 2. Go back to the order's hunt: Bell Station, by boat from Lilmoth, to learn which drowned tower. 3. Bell Station first; or confront Never-Writes-Twice about the cellar and the sap; or find the key. 4. I do not know who or what moans below, or why the order feeds them sap or why the Unbound say the Hist are drained; I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or the Unbound.

answer Notes: Fort Chalkmoth (Archwarden fort, Chixathe Mesa) has a trapdoor in the yard, unlocked, that leads unseen to the order's cellar guardroom. Gaoler Tsleel-Vaku will not talk; persuasion and illusion both failed. The inner cellar door needs a key that Never-Writes-Twice keeps, and a pick will not open it. Something moans behind it. The quartermaster's store above holds jars of Hist sap tied with the knot of Jal-Veesa's tree-minder, in a fort with no Hist of its own. Captain Sakeeus-Wan offered 100 gold to kill three Sarpa raiders on the western approach; I did not do it. Open questions: who or what is in the cellar, and why the order feeds it sap. Next step is Bell Station (boat from Lilmoth) for the drowned tower hunt. I carry the rapier, 2 lockpicks, 3 paralysis poison, the Unbound note, keystone, bronze disc, eye-setting, grave-stake, map and 1050 gold.
